verdict.rationale: Kintsugi says it finds exposure you didn't know you had, registers you, and files with human support. A lookback of the prior year plus current-year transactions identifies when thresholds were crossed and filing obligations began, and CSV upload can backfill historical sales. None of the evidence explicitly describes voluntary disclosure agreements or filing past-due returns for prior periods, so the remediation path is implied rather than documented. Missing for 10: explicit VDA support, documented back-filing of past-due returns or penalty/interest handling, independent corroboration.
